title: Mortgage Loan File Underwriting Table: Large Deposits, Gift Funds, Borrower Contribution and Interested Party Contribution Caps
content:
The asset and contribution limits for a Mortgage Loan File are set per Larkspur program: the deposit size that must be sourced, whether gift funds may be used, the minimum share of the price that must come from the borrower's own funds, and the caps on interested party contributions.

## Deposits, gifts and own funds

| Program | Single deposit that must be sourced | Gift funds allowed | Minimum borrower own funds (percent of the purchase price) |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | 1.0% of the adjusted property value | yes | 0.00% |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | 50.0% of monthly qualifying income | yes | 0.00% |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | 50.0% of monthly qualifying income | yes | 0.00% |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | 50.0% of monthly qualifying income | yes | 0.00% |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | 50.0% of monthly qualifying income | yes | 0.00% |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | 50.0% of monthly qualifying income | yes | 0.00% |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 25.0% of monthly qualifying income | yes | 5.00% |

## Interested party contribution caps

Caps are percentages of the lower of the purchase price and the appraised value. For a primary residence or second home the cap is taken from the first loan-to-value band whose upper limit is at or above the file's base-loan-to-value; an investment property has a single cap.

| Program | Primary residence and second home bands (base-loan-to-value up to: cap) | Investment property cap |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur FHA 30-Year Fixed | up to 100.0%: 6.0% | 0.00% (investment property is not an eligible occupancy) |
| Larkspur VA 30-Year Fixed | up to 100.0%: 4.0% | 0.00% (not an eligible occupancy) |
| Larkspur HomeReady 30-Year Fixed | up to 75.0%: 9.0%; up to 90.0%: 6.0%; up to 97.0%: 3.0% | 0.00% (not an eligible occupancy) |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed | up to 75.0%: 9.0%; up to 90.0%: 6.0%; up to 97.0%: 3.0% | 2.00% |
| Larkspur Conventional 15-Year Fixed | up to 75.0%: 9.0%; up to 90.0%: 6.0%; up to 97.0%: 3.0% | 2.00% |
| Larkspur High-Balance Conforming 30-Year Fixed | up to 75.0%: 9.0%; up to 90.0%: 6.0%; up to 97.0%: 3.0% | 2.00% |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | up to 75.0%: 6.0%; up to 85.0%: 3.0% | 0.00% (not an eligible occupancy) |

## Band selection (hypothetical files)

| Program | File base-loan-to-value | Band that applies | Cap |
|---|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, primary residence | 75.00% | up to 75.0% | 9.0% |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, primary residence | 75.01% | up to 90.0% | 6.0% |
| Larkspur Conventional 30-Year Fixed, second home | 92.00% | up to 97.0% | 3.0% |
| Larkspur Jumbo 30-Year Fixed, primary residence | 80.00% | up to 85.0% | 3.0% |
